trust_decision.summary: Whether the acting user may change auth-state fields (activated, ldap_import, groups, deletion via merge) of a target user is decided by the per-target Gate canEditAuthFields (non-admins cannot touch admins/superusers, admins cannot touch superusers); bulk edit applied activated/ldap_import by mass update outside that gate, and merge never checked it.
